market_morning.title: A Morning at the Market
market_morning.text: Mary went to the market early in the morning. She bought three red apples and a loaf of bread. The sun was shining brightly as she walked back home.
market_morning.q1: Where did Mary go in the morning?
market_morning.q2: How many apples did she buy?

dog_walk.title: Walking the Dog
dog_walk.text: John took his dog, Max, for a walk in the park. Max chased a yellow butterfly near the large oak tree. They stayed there until sunset.

making_tea.title: Making Tea
making_tea.text: Sarah put the kettle on the stove to make some tea. She chose peppermint tea because it was her favorite. She enjoyed it with a small biscuit.
making_tea.q1: What kind of tea did Sarah choose?
making_tea.q2: What did she eat with her tea?

festival_day.title: Festival Day
festival_day.text: The village was decorated with bright lights for the annual festival. The children wore traditional clothes and danced in the center square. Everyone shared sweet rice cakes and celebrated together.

lost_keys.title: The Lost Keys
lost_keys.text: David couldn't find his car keys anywhere. He checked the kitchen counter, the living room table, and finally found them inside his coat pocket. He was relieved and hurried to his appointment.
lost_keys.q1: Where did David finally find his keys?
lost_keys.q2: How did he feel when he found them?

visiting_friend.title: Visiting an Old Friend
visiting_friend.text: Last Sunday, Helen took the train to visit her childhood friend, Alice. They hadn't seen each other for five years. They spent the entire afternoon looking at old photographs and drinking coffee.
visiting_friend.q2: How long had it been since they last met?

childhood_home.title: Return to the Childhood Home
childhood_home.text: After forty years, Robert decided to visit the small house where he grew up. The large mango tree in the front yard was still there, but the old wooden fence had been replaced with a brick wall. He stood by the gate, remembering the summer days he spent playing with his older brother.
childhood_home.q1: How long had it been since Robert visited his childhood home?
childhood_home.q2: What kind of tree was in the front yard?
childhood_home.q3: What replaced the old wooden fence?
childhood_home.q4: Who did Robert remember playing with?

long_journey.title: The Long Journey
long_journey.text: The train ride from the coastal town to the mountains took twelve hours. Maria read three chapters of her novel and watched the landscape change from green fields to snowy peaks. She arrived at the station just as the sun was setting, ready for her winter vacation.
long_journey.q1: How long was the train ride?
long_journey.q2: What did Maria do during the journey?
long_journey.q2_c1: Read three chapters of her novel
long_journey.q3: What did the landscape change into?
long_journey.q4: When did she arrive at the station?
long_journey.q4_c3: In the middle of the night

special_recipe.title: The Special Recipe
special_recipe.text: Grandma always prepared a special chicken soup whenever someone in the family was feeling unwell. Her secret ingredient was a pinch of fresh ginger and some lemon juice. It took three hours to cook perfectly, filling the house with a comforting aroma.
special_recipe.q1: When did Grandma prepare the special soup?
special_recipe.q3: How long did the soup take to cook?
special_recipe.q4: What kind of aroma filled the house?
